default.comment: ADR-0072 D13 — the Action role (ADR-0065 D2): the edge a control takes under the pointer and the icon that answers it. Federation Green at the point of interaction, the same value in every theme

live.comment: ADR-0088 D1 — the live accent: what is happening now or next (a live mark, a countdown, a results feed). Never an action, a state, an achievement, a link or a category. Declared and measured, and used by nothing until the results pages exist (owner decision 2026-09-18)

track.comment: ADR-0088 D2 — the track mark: a line, a fill or a figure on a ground that is dark in all three lists (the black register, a photograph under the hero's wash). Never text on a light ground, never a state. No hue here: no step of it clears 7:1 on white and 15 from this list's states together, so it is drawn as the register's own ink, as the item colours are (ADR-0072 D1)

plate.comment: ADR-0085 D6.1 — the ground behind a third-party mark. Supplied logos arrive on an opaque white ground, so the plate stays white in every list; on a neutral ground its edge is --color-border-strong

pinned-edge.comment: ADR-0086 D3 - the hue is dropped rather than darkened, as ADR-0059 does with every register and ADR-0072 with the item palette: #FFFFFF measures 21:1 on #000000, and this list asks for legibility, not brand expression

marker.comment: ADR-0072 D13 — the location pin on a map card. It stands on map imagery, an unknown ground, so its value does not follow the theme (contact-map.tsx): the same red in every list, measured on the pin card's base ground

muted.comment: ADR-0051 — new; 9.04:1 on white, gives a third tier below primary/secondary without leaving max-contrast philosophy

link.comment: Underline carries the link cue at this contrast level, not color alone

section.comment: ADR-0059 — high contrast deliberately flattens all four registers to black-on-white. A user who selects this mode is asking for maximum legibility, not brand expression; rendering a green or red full-bleed ground would take contrast away from them to make a point they did not ask for.

adjacent-separator.comment: ADR-0059 — a solid black rule, since the registers themselves no longer differ

accent.comment: ADR-0072 D3 — the accent rule, black in high contrast

subtle.comment: ADR-0059 — high contrast collapses subtle into default by design; a weaker rule would defeat the mode

success-text.comment: ADR-0071 D1 — the state's own high-contrast step already carries text: 9.97 on #FFFFFF
